intensity_prior_note: linear_intensity_prior_0_255 is ROUND_HALF_UP(mean_reflectance * 255). It is only a normalized initialization prior and is not raw or calibrated Velodyne HDL-32E intensity.
recommended_sampling: For stochastic simulation, sample from a truncated normal distribution using mean, std, min and max; then apply range, incidence-angle, atmospheric and sensor-response models.

conditions.incidence_angle_note: The property layer does not model incidence-angle dependence; runtime sensor models must apply it separately.
conditions.wet_calibration_note: Wet values are first-order surface-state priors and are not calibrated HDL-32E rain responses.

wavelength_note: LUMA-SLUM values were read at 903.9 nm, the closest available sampled wavelength to the nominal 903 nm wavelength of the Velodyne HDL-32E.

state_model.dry_definition: Dry-state reflectance priors at approximately 903 nm. Depending on the material, values are sample-backed, sample-proxy, engineering priors, or an excluded fallback.
state_model.wet_surface_definition: First-order modification of the dry material prior caused by surface wetting only. Atmospheric rain, droplets, sensor-window wetting, false returns and dropout are outside this property layer.
state_model.wet_evidence_note: Wet means are literature-level first-order priors. Wet uncertainty intervals are engineering bounds and are not direct class-specific measurements or sensor calibrations.

runtime_equations.wet_surface_only: rho_wet_mean = rho_dry_mean * M_wet_mean; rho_wet_min = rho_dry_mean * M_wet_min; rho_wet_max = rho_dry_mean * M_wet_max.

tier_definitions.dry_sample_backed: Dry value computed from samples explicitly assigned to the same UR-MAT material class.
tier_definitions.dry_sample_proxy: Dry value computed from measured samples of a related material used as an explicit proxy for the UR-MAT class.
tier_definitions.dry_engineering_prior: Dry value supplied as an engineering prior because suitable class-specific samples were not available.
tier_definitions.wet_literature_prior: Wet mean multiplier based on a first-order literature-level trend, not a direct measurement for the individual UR-MAT class.
tier_definitions.wet_engineering_interval: Wet minimum and maximum multipliers are engineering uncertainty bounds, not measured confidence intervals.
tier_definitions.fallback_excluded: Fallback retained for schema completeness but excluded from quantitative evaluation and calibrated simulation.
